name: scmjs-plugin-eudplib
description: eudplib — the EUD trigger compiler behind euddraft, run inside the scmJS map editor as a library other plugins build with.
author: Jeany

scripts.build: esbuild plugin.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --platform=browser --loader:.py=text --outfile=dist/plugin.js --banner:js="// Generated by npm run build - do not edit; the source is plugin.ts." && esbuild src/eudplib.worker.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --platform=browser --loader:.py=text --outfile=dist/worker.js --banner:js="// Generated by npm run build - do not edit; the source is src/eudplib.worker.ts. The build worker imports this from the CDN at the plugin's version tag."
